definition: Version of the snapshot manifest contract.
missing_value_policy: Required; unsupported versions stop installation.
scope: Operational metadata; not a housing variable.

definition: GitHub repository receiving and supplying the private release.
missing_value_policy: Required; must match configured repository.
scope: Operational metadata; no access rights are granted by this value.

definition: Versioned release identifier for this database snapshot.
source_or_derivation: Publisher-supplied unique tag with the configured prefix.
missing_value_policy: Required; must match the selected release.
scope: Operational metadata; distinct from provider source vintage.

definition: Time the validated local database copy was packaged.
source_or_derivation: Actual publisher packaging clock in UTC.
missing_value_policy: Required; never inferred from source observation dates.
scope: Packaging time; not the original database build date.

definition: Full Git commit of the clean code checkout used for the required validation checks.
source_or_derivation: Local Git HEAD checked before and after validation and packaging.
missing_value_policy: Required; collaborator installation requires the same clean commit.
scope: Validation compatibility; does not assert the revision that originally ingested every observation.

definition: Identity and byte-integrity metadata for the attached database.
source_or_derivation: Inspection of the completed packaged file.
missing_value_policy: Required.
scope: Operational metadata; original provenance remains inside the database.

definition: Release database asset filename.
missing_value_policy: Required; unexpected names are refused.
scope: Managed database attachment.

definition: Size of the packaged database in bytes.
source_or_derivation: Filesystem size after the stable copy.
missing_value_policy: Required positive value within the configured transfer limit.
scope: Byte count; not observation count.

definition: SHA-256 checksum of the complete packaged database file.
source_or_derivation: Hash of the copied file verified against the stable source.
missing_value_policy: Required lowercase 64-character hexadecimal value; download must match.
scope: Transfer integrity; distinct from provider-file checksums stored in the database.

definition: DuckDB Python library version used when preparing the snapshot.
missing_value_policy: Required nonempty version string.
scope: Runtime metadata; database inspection determines local readability.

definition: Read-only inspection results for the packaged database structure and coverage.
source_or_derivation: Database schema metadata and stored-table queries.
missing_value_policy: Required.
scope: Operational inventory; does not transform observations.

definition: SHA-256 of the ordered schema column inventory.
missing_value_policy: Required; checked against the downloaded database.
scope: Structural integrity rather than a scientific method identifier.

definition: Mapping from schema-qualified stored table names to row counts.
source_or_derivation: Read-only COUNT queries on stored base tables.
missing_value_policy: Required nonnegative counts; configured required tables must be present.
scope: Counts do not imply equal table grain or complete provider coverage.

definition: Overall date span and row count of the housing observation fact table.
missing_value_policy: Required object; endpoints may be null for an empty fact table.
scope: Aggregate inventory; variable-specific coverage remains in database metadata.

definition: Earliest observation_date in the housing observation fact table.
missing_value_policy: Null when the table has no dated observations; never filled.
scope: Observation date; not retrieval or release date.

definition: Latest observation_date in the housing observation fact table.
missing_value_policy: Null when the table has no dated observations; never filled.
scope: Does not claim every source extends to this date.

definition: Number of stored housing fact observation rows.
missing_value_policy: Zero is retained when empty; never fabricated.
scope: Row count preserves the existing grain and geography distinctions.

definition: Results of the required publisher verification commands.
missing_value_policy: Both required checks must be present and successful.
scope: Validation evidence; no successful ingestion is inferred.

definition: Required project test-suite result.
missing_value_policy: Publication stops on a nonzero exit.
scope: Actual check execution; not an operator-entered assertion.

definition: Test-suite process exit code.
missing_value_policy: Required and must equal zero.
scope: Operational validation status.

definition: Completion time of the successful test suite.
source_or_derivation: Actual UTC clock after process completion.
missing_value_policy: Required UTC timestamp.
scope: Check time; not source vintage.

definition: Required structural and project data validation result.
missing_value_policy: Publication stops on a nonzero exit.
scope: Validation may update QA metadata but does not refresh provider observations.

definition: Pipeline validation process exit code.
missing_value_policy: Required and must equal zero.
scope: Structural QA failures prevent packaging.

definition: Completion time of successful pipeline validation.
source_or_derivation: Actual UTC clock after process completion.
missing_value_policy: Required UTC timestamp.
scope: Check time; not original database build time.

definition: Scope and notice accompanying the full research snapshot.
source_or_derivation: Publisher access policy and restricted-data inspection.
missing_value_policy: Required.
scope: Distribution metadata; does not grant a license.

definition: Intended recipient audience.
missing_value_policy: Required exact value.
scope: Publication additionally requires private repository verification and an operator acknowledgement.

definition: Whether configured HUD-USPS markers are detected in schema names or fact observations.
source_or_derivation: Inspection of HUD-USPS table names and USPS column/variable/source markers.
missing_value_policy: Required boolean; false is not a general legal clearance.
scope: Detection flag; no restricted observations are removed or altered.

definition: Text preserving provider and institutional restrictions for recipients.
missing_value_policy: Required nonempty text.
scope: Repository membership alone does not authorize source-data redistribution.

definition: Local installation or recognition time for the managed snapshot.
source_or_derivation: Updater clock after successful verification and installation or recognition.
missing_value_policy: Written only for a verified installation.
scope: Local state; not published source provenance.

definition: Entire received manifest retained as the installed database baseline.
source_or_derivation: Verified housing.snapshot.json received from the selected release.
missing_value_policy: Missing or inconsistent state never authorizes replacement of an unknown database.
scope: Used to detect local changes before later updates.
